title: hesperis scapigera
intro: Hesperis scapigera, commonly known as the Cornish rocket, is a perennial flowering plant that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hesperis scapigera include its use as a demulcent to soothe irritated tissues and as a diuretic to help eliminate excess fluids from the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and flavonoids, which may contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
